blocks.en: Symbol Categories 5.5–5.6 (Precautions and Identification), Annexes A & B, Bibliography

blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Identify and apply all Category 5.5 precautionary symbols — Caution, IFU, Biohazard, Latex, Non-pyrogenic, Rx-only — on medical device labels 識別並應用所有 5.5 類警示符號於醫療器材標籤
blocks.en: Identify and apply all Category 5.5 precautionary symbols — Caution, IFU, Biohazard, Latex, Non-pyrogenic, Rx-only — on medical device labels

blocks.zh: Identify and apply all Category 5.6 identification symbols — REF, LOT, SN, Catalogue, GMDN, QTY, IVD — and understand their regulatory significance 識別並應用所有 5.6 類識別符號並理解其法規意涵
blocks.en: Identify and apply all Category 5.6 identification symbols — REF, LOT, SN, Catalogue, GMDN, QTY, IVD — and understand their regulatory significance

blocks.zh: Understand how Annex A demonstrates multi-symbol label layouts for real devices 理解附錄 A 如何展示真實器材的多符號標籤排版
blocks.en: Understand how Annex A demonstrates multi-symbol label layouts for real devices

blocks.zh: Understand how Annex B constructs compound negation symbols using the prohibition circle 理解附錄 B 如何以禁止圓圈構建複合否定符號
blocks.en: Understand how Annex B constructs compound negation symbols using the prohibition circle

blocks.zh: Apply LOT, SN, and REF correctly under DSCSA/EU MDR UDI requirements 在 DSCSA/EU MDR UDI 要求下正確應用 LOT、SN 和 REF 符號
blocks.en: Apply LOT, SN, and REF correctly under DSCSA/EU MDR UDI requirements

blocks.zh: Complete a pharma CDMO label compliance checklist for sterile injectable devices 完成製藥 CDMO 無菌注射器材的標籤合規清單
blocks.en: Complete a pharma CDMO label compliance checklist for sterile injectable devices

blocks.zh: Clause 5.5 — Precautionary Symbols 警示類符號
blocks.en: Clause 5.5 — Precautionary Symbols

blocks.zh: 為何警示符號如此重要？製藥 CDMO 視角
blocks.en: Why precautionary symbols matter: a pharma CDMO perspective

blocks.zh: 在製藥 CDMO 環境中，標籤警示符號是最後一道防線。當醫護人員在 ICU 取用無菌注射劑時，他們沒有時間閱讀完整說明書——一眼掃過符號就必須傳達所有關鍵風險訊息。
blocks.en: In a pharma CDMO setting, label warning symbols are the last line of defense. When a clinician picks up a sterile injectable in the ICU, there is no time to read the full instructions for use; one glance at the symbols must convey every critical risk message.

blocks.zh: 類比：交通號誌的力量
blocks.en: Analogy: the power of road signs

blocks.zh: 警告三角形（Caution 符號）就像道路上的「前方危險」號誌——不論駕駛者講何種語言，立即傳達「需要注意」的訊息。ISO 15223-1 的目標是讓器材符號達到同樣的普世可讀性。
blocks.en: The warning triangle (Caution symbol) is like a "danger ahead" road sign: whatever language the driver speaks, it immediately says "pay attention". ISO 15223-1 aims to give device symbols the same universal readability.

blocks.zh: 法規連結
blocks.en: Regulatory links

blocks.zh: EU MDR 2017/745 Annex I: 要求標籤包含所有必要警示，並優先使用 EN ISO 15223-1 符號
blocks.en: EU MDR 2017/745 Annex I: requires labels to carry all necessary warnings and gives preference to EN ISO 15223-1 symbols

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR Part 801: 允許使用 ISO 符號取代英文文字，前提是符號必須符合 ISO 15223-1
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR Part 801: allows ISO symbols in place of English text, provided the symbols conform to ISO 15223-1

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 風險管理: 標籤符號是風險控制措施之一，需納入殘餘風險評估
blocks.en: ISO 14971 risk management: label symbols are one of the risk control measures and must be included in the residual risk evaluation

blocks.zh: 5.5.1 Caution & Consult Instructions for Use 注意與查閱使用說明
blocks.en: 5.5.1 Caution & Consult Instructions for Use

blocks.zh: 表示使用者需查閱使用說明，以獲取重要的注意事項或警告資訊。
blocks.en: Indicates that the user needs to consult the instructions for use for important cautionary information or warnings.

blocks.zh: 表示使用前必須查閱使用說明書（IFU）。常與 Caution 三角形搭配使用。
blocks.en: Indicates that the instructions for use (IFU) must be consulted before use. Often used together with the Caution triangle.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實作：何時必須印 Caution 符號？
blocks.en: CDMO practice: when must the Caution symbol be printed?

blocks.zh: 強制性警示符號場合
blocks.en: Situations where a warning symbol is mandatory

blocks.zh: 無菌注射器材：「單次使用」（Do Not Reuse）旁必須有 Caution 標記
blocks.en: Sterile injectable devices: a Caution mark must appear next to "single use" (Do Not Reuse)

blocks.zh: 含有毒性成分的器材（如細胞毒性藥物預填充注射器）
blocks.en: Devices containing toxic components (e.g., prefilled syringes with cytotoxic drugs)

blocks.zh: 需要特殊儲存條件（光敏、溫敏）的器材
blocks.en: Devices requiring special storage conditions (light-sensitive, temperature-sensitive)

blocks.zh: 有電磁干擾（MRI/起搏器）禁忌症的器材
blocks.en: Devices with electromagnetic interference contraindications (MRI/pacemaker)

blocks.zh: FDA 510(k) 要求在標籤上包含所有 IDE 試驗中發現的已知風險
blocks.en: FDA 510(k) requires the label to include all known risks identified in IDE studies

blocks.zh: IFU 符號的特殊規定
blocks.en: Special rules for the IFU symbol

blocks.zh: 根據 EU MDR Annex I Section 23.4 (m)，如果器材複雜到無法將所有安全資訊放在標籤上，製造商必須同時提供：
blocks.en: Under EU MDR Annex I Section 23.4 (m), if a device is too complex to put all safety information on the label, the manufacturer must provide both of the following:

blocks.zh: 紙質 IFU（要求時可以電子版替代）
blocks.en: A paper IFU (an electronic version may replace it on request)

blocks.zh: 標籤上的 IFU 符號（必須明顯可見）
blocks.en: The IFU symbol on the label (it must be clearly visible)

blocks.zh: 電子 IFU（eIFU）的存取方式
blocks.en: Access instructions for the electronic IFU (eIFU)

blocks.zh: 歐盟 Regulation (EU) No 207/2012 允許特定器材類別以電子 IFU 完全取代紙本，但標籤上的 IFU 符號仍須保留。
blocks.en: Regulation (EU) No 207/2012 allows certain device categories to replace the paper IFU entirely with an eIFU, but the IFU symbol on the label must still be retained.

blocks.zh: 快速判斷：需要 Caution 還是 IFU 符號？
blocks.en: Quick decision: Caution or IFU symbol?

blocks.zh: 問自己三個問題：
blocks.en: Ask yourself three questions:

blocks.zh: 標籤空間是否足夠放入完整警告文字？→ 不夠 → 用符號
blocks.en: Is there enough label space for the full warning text? If not, use a symbol

blocks.zh: 使用者是否需要特定步驟指引才能安全使用？→ 是 → 加 IFU 書本符號
blocks.en: Does the user need step-by-step guidance to use the device safely? If yes, add the IFU book symbol

blocks.zh: 是否有具體危害（毒性、感染、電擊）？→ 是 → 加 Caution 三角形
blocks.en: Is there a specific hazard (toxicity, infection, electric shock)? If yes, add the Caution triangle

blocks.zh: 5.5.2 Biological Risks — Biohazard Symbol 生物危害符號
blocks.en: 5.5.2 Biological Risks — Biohazard Symbol

blocks.zh: 表示該物品存在生物危害——含有或接觸過潛在感染性物質（血液、體液、病原體）。
blocks.en: Indicates a biological hazard: the item contains, or has been in contact with, potentially infectious material (blood, body fluids, pathogens).

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：生物危害符號使用指南
blocks.en: CDMO scenarios: guide to using the Biohazard symbol

blocks.zh: 類比：核電廠輻射符號
blocks.en: Analogy: the nuclear plant radiation symbol

blocks.zh: Biohazard 符號與輻射符號（☢）一樣，是全球通用的「停！需要特殊處理」訊號。即使在資源有限的環境，醫護人員都受過辨識這個符號的訓練。
blocks.en: Like the radiation symbol (☢), the Biohazard symbol is a globally recognized "stop, special handling required" signal. Even in resource-limited settings, healthcare workers are trained to recognize it.

blocks.zh: 製藥 CDMO 特別注意事項
blocks.en: Points for special attention at a pharma CDMO

blocks.zh: 自體輸血器材：患者自身血液回輸系統必須標示 Biohazard，因為血液本身視為潛在感染源
blocks.en: Autotransfusion devices: systems that return the patient's own blood must carry the Biohazard symbol, because the blood itself is treated as a potential source of infection

blocks.zh: 診斷試劑盒：含人血清陽性對照品的 IVD 試劑盒必須標示
blocks.en: Diagnostic kits: IVD kits containing positive control material made from human serum must be marked

blocks.zh: 細菌過濾器：使用後成為感染性廢棄物，包裝上應預先標示 Biohazard（建議做法）
blocks.en: Bacterial filters: after use they become infectious waste, so the packaging should be pre-marked with Biohazard (recommended practice)

blocks.zh: 血糖試紙：用於全血測試的試紙，使用後應被視為潛在生物危害
blocks.en: Blood glucose test strips: strips used for whole-blood testing should be treated as a potential biohazard after use

blocks.zh: 避免濫用 Biohazard 符號
blocks.en: Avoid overusing the Biohazard symbol

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤：將 Biohazard 符號印在所有與人體接觸的器材上（如一般繃帶、棉棒）。ISO 15223-1 明確指出，此符號應僅用於確實存在感染傳播風險的情況。過度使用會造成警示疲勞（alert fatigue），降低符號的警示效果。
blocks.en: A common mistake is to print the Biohazard symbol on every device that touches the human body (e.g., ordinary bandages, cotton swabs). ISO 15223-1 clearly states that this symbol should be used only where there is a real risk of transmitting infection. Overuse causes alert fatigue and weakens the warning effect of the symbol.

blocks.zh: 決策樹：是否需要 Biohazard 符號？
blocks.en: Decision tree: is the Biohazard symbol needed?

blocks.zh: 器材是否接觸血液/體液/病原體？→ 是
blocks.en: Does the device contact blood, body fluids or pathogens? If yes, use it

blocks.zh: 是否為 IVD 試劑含人源性材料？→ 是
blocks.en: Is it an IVD reagent containing human-derived material? If yes, use it

blocks.zh: 是否為感染性廢棄物容器？→ 是
blocks.en: Is it an infectious waste container? If yes, use it

blocks.zh: 是否為一般消毒後的無菌器材？→ 否（不應標示）
blocks.en: Is it an ordinary sterilized sterile device? No (it should not be marked)

blocks.zh: 5.5.3–5.5.5 Latex / Non-pyrogenic / Rx Only 乳膠 / 非熱原性 / 僅限處方
blocks.en: 5.5.3–5.5.5 Latex / Non-pyrogenic / Rx Only

blocks.zh: 器材含天然橡膠乳膠（NRL）。乳膠過敏對某些患者具有生命威脅，FDA 要求所有含 NRL 的器材必須標示。
blocks.en: The device contains natural rubber latex (NRL). Latex allergy can be life-threatening for some patients, and FDA requires all devices containing NRL to be labeled.

blocks.zh: 表示器材不含熱原（細菌內毒素或其他致熱物質）。對靜脈內或椎管內器材至關重要。
blocks.en: Indicates that the device is free of pyrogens (bacterial endotoxin or other fever-inducing substances). Essential for intravenous or intraspinal devices.

blocks.zh: 器材為處方器材，不得在未經醫師處方的情況下使用。對應美國 21 CFR 801.109 和歐盟 MDR 限制性銷售要求。
blocks.en: The device is a prescription device and must not be used without a physician's prescription. Corresponds to 21 CFR 801.109 in the US and the restricted-sale requirements of the EU MDR.

blocks.zh: 三個關鍵警示符號的 CDMO 實作含義
blocks.en: CDMO practice implications of the three key precautionary symbols

blocks.zh: Latex 符號：CDMO 風險管理重點
blocks.en: Latex symbol: CDMO risk management priorities

blocks.zh: FDA 要求：21 CFR 801.437 強制要求所有含 NRL 的器材在最外層包裝和器材標籤上均須標示
blocks.en: FDA requirement: 21 CFR 801.437 requires all devices containing NRL to be marked on the outermost package and on the device label

blocks.zh: 供應鏈追溯：CDMO 必須確認所有橡膠組件（活塞、隔膜、密封件）的來源是否含 NRL
blocks.en: Supply chain traceability: the CDMO must confirm whether the source of every rubber component (plunger, diaphragm, seal) contains NRL

blocks.zh: 替代材料：近年趨勢是使用合成橡膠（如丁腈橡膠）替代 NRL，可使用「Latex-Free」聲明（但 ISO 並未標準化此符號）
blocks.en: Alternative materials: the recent trend is to replace NRL with synthetic rubber (e.g., nitrile rubber), and a "Latex-Free" statement may be used (but ISO has not standardized a symbol for it)

blocks.zh: 標籤顏色：許多製造商使用紅色背景或紅色框線強調此符號（非 ISO 要求，但是業界慣例）
blocks.en: Label color: many manufacturers use a red background or red border to emphasize this symbol (not an ISO requirement, but common industry practice)

blocks.zh: Non-Pyrogenic 符號：測試要求
blocks.en: Non-Pyrogenic symbol: testing requirements

blocks.zh: USP <85> 細菌內毒素測試（BET）：LAL（鱟試劑）或重組 rFC 法
blocks.en: USP <85> Bacterial Endotoxins Test (BET): LAL (Limulus amebocyte lysate) or recombinant factor C (rFC) method

blocks.zh: USP <151> 熱原測試：家兔法（特殊情況）
blocks.en: USP <151> Pyrogen Test: rabbit test (special cases)

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-11：對於無法使用 LAL 測試的器材（如某些高分子材料），需用替代方法
blocks.en: ISO 10993-11: for devices that cannot be tested with LAL (e.g., some polymeric materials), an alternative method is needed

blocks.zh: CDMO 合規：批次放行前必須有 COA 證明熱原測試合格，方可在標籤上印 Non-Pyrogenic 符號
blocks.en: CDMO compliance: before batch release, a COA showing a passing pyrogen test result must be in place before the Non-Pyrogenic symbol may be printed on the label

blocks.zh: Clause 5.6 — Identification and Reference Symbols 識別與參考資訊符號
blocks.en: Clause 5.6 — Identification and Reference Symbols

blocks.zh: UDI 架構：識別符號是現代標籤的骨架
blocks.en: UDI framework: identification symbols are the backbone of the modern label

blocks.zh: 現代醫療器材標籤的 UDI 要求本質上是「強制要求使用 ISO 15223-1 識別符號」的法規化。理解這些符號，就是理解 UDI 系統的標籤語言。
blocks.en: The UDI requirements for modern medical device labels are essentially a regulatory codification of "mandatory use of ISO 15223-1 identification symbols". Understanding these symbols means understanding the labeling language of the UDI system.

blocks.zh: 類比：產品條碼系統
blocks.en: Analogy: the product barcode system

blocks.zh: 想像超市商品：條碼（GS1 DataBar）包含製造商代碼、品項代碼和批號。ISO 15223-1 的識別符號就是「標籤旁邊告訴你各段數字意義」的標記——REF 告訴你「這是型號」，LOT 告訴你「這是批號」，就像超市貨架上的「商品名稱」和「有效日期」標籤。
blocks.en: Think of supermarket goods: the barcode (GS1 DataBar) contains the manufacturer code, item code and lot number. The ISO 15223-1 identification symbols are the markers beside the label that tell you what each group of digits means: REF says "this is the model number" and LOT says "this is the lot number", just like the "product name" and "expiry date" tags on a supermarket shelf.

blocks.zh: UDI 的三層結構與 ISO 符號對應
blocks.en: The three UDI layers and the corresponding ISO symbols

blocks.zh: DI（Device Identifier）：使用 REF 符號標識 → 型號/目錄號
blocks.en: DI (Device Identifier): identified with the REF symbol → model/catalogue number

blocks.zh: PI（Production Identifier）：使用 LOT 和/或 SN 符號標識 → 批次或序號
blocks.en: PI (Production Identifier): identified with the LOT and/or SN symbols → lot or serial number

blocks.zh: AI（Additional Identifier）：使用 QTY、GMDN 等符號 → 數量、分類代碼
blocks.en: AI (Additional Identifier): uses symbols such as QTY and GMDN → quantity, classification code

blocks.zh: 全球 UDI 資料庫要求
blocks.en: Global UDI database requirements

blocks.zh: 美國 GUDID：FDA 全球 UDI 資料庫，所有在美上市器材須登錄
blocks.en: US GUDID: FDA's Global UDI Database; all devices marketed in the US must be registered

blocks.zh: 歐盟 EUDAMED：歐洲器材資料庫，MDR/IVDR 強制要求
blocks.en: EU EUDAMED: the European device database; mandatory under MDR/IVDR

blocks.zh: 台灣 MDDB：食藥署醫療器材資料庫，高風險器材適用
blocks.en: Taiwan MDDB: the TFDA medical device database; applies to higher-risk devices

blocks.zh: 5.6.1–5.6.3 REF / LOT / SN — The UDI Triad 5.6.1–5.6.3 REF / LOT / SN — UDI 三元組
blocks.en: 5.6.1–5.6.3 REF / LOT / SN — The UDI Triad

blocks.zh: 識別製造商的目錄號/型號/參考編號。在同一製造商產品組合中區分不同器材類型。為 UDI 中的器材識別碼（DI）。
blocks.en: Identifies the manufacturer's catalogue number, model number or reference number. Distinguishes different device types within the same manufacturer's portfolio. It is the device identifier (DI) in the UDI.

blocks.zh: 識別製造批次。批次碼使同一生產批次的所有單元可追溯——對於精準召回、不良事件調查和根本原因分析至關重要。
blocks.en: Identifies the manufacturing lot. The lot code makes all units from the same production lot traceable, which is essential for precise recalls, adverse event investigations and root cause analysis.

blocks.zh: 識別特定的個別器材單元。不同於批次碼識別群體，序號對每個實體器材是唯一的。UDI 要求植入性器材（第三類）必須使用序號。
blocks.en: Identifies a specific individual device unit. Unlike the lot code, which identifies a group, the serial number is unique to each physical device. UDI requires a serial number for implantable (Class III) devices.

blocks.zh: REF / LOT / SN：CDMO 標籤設計決策指南
blocks.en: REF / LOT / SN: guide to CDMO label design decisions

blocks.zh: REF 符號的 CDMO 配置注意事項
blocks.en: CDMO configuration points for the REF symbol

blocks.zh: 型號結構：REF 後的代碼通常編碼材質、尺寸、滅菌狀態等資訊（如 REF 4521-ST-20G 中 ST=Sterile, 20G=20 gauge）
blocks.en: Model number structure: the code after REF usually encodes material, size, sterility status and so on (e.g., in REF 4521-ST-20G, ST = Sterile and 20G = 20 gauge)

blocks.zh: 變更管理：器材設計變更（MCN）通常觸發新的 REF，需重新向 FDA/MDR 報告
blocks.en: Change management: a device design change (MCN) usually triggers a new REF, which must be reported again to FDA/under the MDR

blocks.zh: 客製化器材：CDMO 為客戶生產時，使用客戶的 REF（品牌方型號），非 CDMO 自身型號
blocks.en: Custom devices: when a CDMO manufactures for a client, it uses the client's REF (the brand owner's model number), not the CDMO's own model number

blocks.zh: GS1 整合：REF 通常對應 GS1 Application Identifier (01) — GTIN
blocks.en: GS1 integration: REF usually corresponds to GS1 Application Identifier (01) — GTIN

blocks.zh: LOT 符號：批次號設計最佳實踐
blocks.en: LOT symbol: best practices for lot number design

blocks.zh: 編碼邏輯：建議包含年份+月份+流水號，如 26J15-001 (2026年10月15日第1批)
blocks.en: Coding logic: include year + month + sequence number, e.g., 26J15-001 (lot 1 of 15 October 2026)

blocks.zh: 唯一性：同一廠商的 LOT 號在其產品生命週期內必須唯一
blocks.en: Uniqueness: a manufacturer's LOT numbers must be unique over the life of its product

blocks.zh: 召回觸發：FDA/MDR 召回以 LOT 為單位，標籤上的 LOT 清晰可讀是召回效率的關鍵
blocks.en: Recall trigger: FDA/MDR recalls are made by LOT, so a clearly legible LOT on the label is key to recall efficiency

blocks.zh: GS1 對應：LOT 對應 GS1 AI (10) — Batch/Lot Number
blocks.en: GS1 mapping: LOT corresponds to GS1 AI (10) — Batch/Lot Number

blocks.zh: 字體：FDA 21 CFR 801 建議最小 1/16 英寸高度（約 1.6 mm），確保可讀性
blocks.en: Font: FDA 21 CFR 801 recommends a minimum height of 1/16 inch (about 1.6 mm) to ensure legibility

blocks.zh: SN 符號：植入性器材合規要求
blocks.en: SN symbol: compliance requirements for implantable devices

blocks.zh: 根據 EU MDR Article 27(4)，Class III 和主動植入器材（active implantable devices）必須在標籤和 UDI 載體上包含序號（SN）。這意味著：
blocks.en: Under EU MDR Article 27(4), Class III and active implantable devices must include a serial number (SN) on the label and on the UDI carrier. This means:

blocks.zh: 心臟起搏器、人工關節、可植入感測器：強制 SN
blocks.en: Pacemakers, artificial joints, implantable sensors: SN is mandatory

blocks.zh: 單次使用注射器、試紙：LOT 即可
blocks.en: Single-use syringes, test strips: LOT is sufficient

blocks.zh: SN 必須在 EUDAMED（歐盟）或 GUDID（美國）中可查詢
blocks.en: The SN must be searchable in EUDAMED (EU) or GUDID (US)

blocks.zh: 類比：LOT vs SN 如同「航班號 vs 座位號」
blocks.en: Analogy: LOT vs SN is like "flight number vs seat number"

blocks.zh: LOT 就像「航班號」——識別同一批次出廠的所有器材（同一航班的所有乘客）；SN 就像「座位號」——唯一識別特定的那一個器材（那個特定座位上的那個乘客）。召回時：知道 LOT 可以召回整批；知道 SN 可以精準找到那一個器材在哪個患者身上。
blocks.en: LOT is like the "flight number": it identifies all devices released in the same lot (all the passengers on the same flight). SN is like the "seat number": it uniquely identifies one specific device (the one passenger in that particular seat). In a recall, knowing the LOT lets you recall the whole lot; knowing the SN lets you pinpoint exactly which patient has that one device.

blocks.zh: 5.6.4–5.6.7 Catalogue / GMDN / Quantity / IVD 5.6.4–5.6.7 目錄 / GMDN / 數量 / IVD
blocks.en: 5.6.4–5.6.7 Catalogue / GMDN / Quantity / IVD

blocks.zh: 識別製造商的目錄號。與 REF 不同：REF 是器材型號識別碼，目錄號可能是配銷商或訂購參考號，與原廠 REF 不同。
blocks.en: Identifies the manufacturer's catalogue number. Different from REF: REF is the device model identifier, whereas the catalogue number may be a distributor's or ordering reference number that differs from the original manufacturer's REF.

blocks.zh: 識別由 GMDN 機構分配的全球醫療器材命名代碼（5 位數）。用於法規申報、採購和 UDI 資料庫。例如：34774 = 一次性皮下注射器。
blocks.en: Identifies the Global Medical Device Nomenclature code (5 digits) assigned by the GMDN Agency. Used in regulatory submissions, procurement and UDI databases. For example, 34774 = single-use hypodermic syringe.

blocks.zh: 表示包裝中的物品數量。用於數量不自明的包裝，特別是無法看見內部數量的無菌屏障系統包裝。
blocks.en: Indicates the number of items in the package. Used for packages where the quantity is not self-evident, especially sterile barrier system packages where the contents cannot be seen.

blocks.zh: 表示該器材為體外診斷（IVD）醫療器材，用於檢測來自人體的樣本，以提供診斷、監測或生理狀態判定的資訊。
blocks.en: Indicates that the device is an in vitro diagnostic (IVD) medical device, used to examine specimens derived from the human body to provide information for diagnosis, monitoring or determination of a physiological state.

blocks.zh: 進階識別符號的 CDMO 應用指南
blocks.en: CDMO application guide for advanced identification symbols

blocks.zh: GMDN 代碼：為什麼 CDMO 需要了解？
blocks.en: GMDN code: why does a CDMO need to know it?

blocks.zh: GMDN 代碼是全球器材採購和法規申報的通用語言。對 CDMO 的實際影響：
blocks.en: The GMDN code is the common language of global device procurement and regulatory submissions. Practical impact on a CDMO:

blocks.zh: EU MDR EUDAMED 登錄：每個 UDI-DI 必須關聯正確的 GMDN 代碼
blocks.en: EU MDR EUDAMED registration: every UDI-DI must be linked to the correct GMDN code

blocks.zh: WHO 採購：WHO/UNICEF 器材採購規格使用 GMDN 代碼定義產品
blocks.en: WHO procurement: WHO/UNICEF device procurement specifications use GMDN codes to define products

blocks.zh: 市場調研：GMDN 代碼可用於競品分析和市場規模估算
blocks.en: Market research: GMDN codes can be used for competitor analysis and market size estimation

blocks.zh: 客戶要求：越來越多醫院採購部門要求供應商在 COA 上列出 GMDN 代碼
blocks.en: Customer requirements: a growing number of hospital purchasing departments require suppliers to list the GMDN code on the COA

blocks.zh: IVD 符號：IVDR 2017/746 合規重點
blocks.en: IVD symbol: key points for IVDR 2017/746 compliance

blocks.zh: 強制標示：EU IVDR 要求所有 IVD 器材標籤必須包含 IVD 符號，無論風險等級
blocks.en: Mandatory marking: EU IVDR requires the labels of all IVD devices to carry the IVD symbol, regardless of risk class

blocks.zh: 符號位置：建議放置在標籤右上角或器材名稱旁，確保清晰可見
blocks.en: Symbol placement: recommended in the upper right corner of the label or next to the device name, to ensure it is clearly visible

blocks.zh: FDA IVD：美國 21 CFR Part 809 允許使用 IVD 符號，但不強制要求 ISO 版本
blocks.en: FDA IVD: US 21 CFR Part 809 permits use of the IVD symbol but does not require the ISO version

blocks.zh: 自我測試 IVD：家用血糖計、COVID 快篩等，需額外標示「For self-testing」聲明
blocks.en: Self-testing IVDs: home blood glucose meters, COVID rapid tests and similar products need an additional "For self-testing" statement

blocks.zh: QTY 符號的常見錯誤
blocks.en: Common errors with the QTY symbol

blocks.zh: 在有 CE 標誌的歐洲市場，歐盟委員會執行調查發現以下常見錯誤：
blocks.en: In the European market, where CE marking applies, European Commission enforcement surveys found the following common errors:

blocks.zh: 外箱印 QTY 10，但內部實際為 12 個（包裝設計變更未同步更新標籤）
blocks.en: The outer carton is printed QTY 10, but actually contains 12 (a packaging design change was not matched by a label update)

blocks.zh: 未區分「包裝數量」和「可用單位數量」——例如一盒含 5 個托盤，每托盤 10 個，標籤應標示 QTY 50，而非 QTY 5
blocks.en: No distinction between "package quantity" and "usable unit quantity": for example, a box containing 5 trays of 10 units each should be labeled QTY 50, not QTY 5

blocks.zh: 多語言標籤中，QTY 符號被誤譯為體積單位（數量 vs 容量的混淆）
blocks.en: In multilingual labels, the QTY symbol was mistranslated as a unit of volume (confusion between quantity and capacity)

blocks.zh: 案例：CDMO 為 IVD 試劑盒設計標籤
blocks.en: Case: a CDMO designs the label for an IVD kit

blocks.zh: 產品：COVID-19 抗原快篩試劑盒（含 25 個測試）
blocks.en: Product: COVID-19 antigen rapid test kit (25 tests)

blocks.zh: 需要使用的 ISO 15223-1 符號：
blocks.en: ISO 15223-1 symbols to be used:

blocks.zh: IVD — 標示為體外診斷器材
blocks.en: IVD — identifies an in vitro diagnostic device

blocks.zh: REF — 產品型號（DI 組件）
blocks.en: REF — product model number (DI component)

blocks.zh: LOT — 批次號（PI 組件）
blocks.en: LOT — lot number (PI component)

blocks.zh: QTY 25 — 盒內含 25 個測試
blocks.en: QTY 25 — the box contains 25 tests

blocks.zh: Caution / IFU — 提示查閱操作說明
blocks.en: Caution / IFU — prompts the user to consult the operating instructions

blocks.zh: Biohazard — 含人源陽性對照品
blocks.en: Biohazard — contains human-derived positive control

blocks.zh: GMDN 代碼（建議標示）
blocks.en: GMDN code (recommended)
Expiry date / date of manufacture (ISO 7000-1570 / 7000-1424)

blocks.zh: Annex A (Informative) — Examples of Symbol Use on Medical Device Labels 符號使用範例
blocks.en: Annex A (Informative) — Examples of Symbol Use on Medical Device Labels

blocks.zh: 標籤設計：符號排列的最佳實踐
blocks.en: Label design: best practices for symbol layout

blocks.zh: 符號分組原則（Annex A 核心教訓）
blocks.en: Symbol grouping principles (the core lesson of Annex A)

blocks.zh: ISO 15223-1 Annex A 展示的標籤設計遵循以下分組邏輯：
blocks.en: The label designs shown in ISO 15223-1 Annex A follow this grouping logic:

blocks.zh: 第一區 — 產品識別：品牌名、器材名稱、規格
blocks.en: Zone 1 — Product identification: brand name, device name, specifications

blocks.zh: 第二區 — 追溯識別：REF + LOT/SN + QTY（UDI 核心資訊）
blocks.en: Zone 2 — Traceability identification: REF + LOT/SN + QTY (core UDI information)

blocks.zh: 第三區 — 日期資訊：製造日、有效期
blocks.en: Zone 3 — Date information: date of manufacture, expiry date

blocks.zh: 第四區 — 儲存/環境：溫度、濕度、光照條件
blocks.en: Zone 4 — Storage/environment: temperature, humidity, light conditions

blocks.zh: 第五區 — 警示符號：Caution、Biohazard、Latex、Rx Only
blocks.en: Zone 5 — Warning symbols: Caution, Biohazard, Latex, Rx Only

blocks.zh: 第六區 — 法規資訊：CE 標誌、授權代理人、GS1 條碼/QR 碼
blocks.en: Zone 6 — Regulatory information: CE mark, authorized representative, GS1 barcode/QR code

blocks.zh: 類比：標籤是「器材的身分證」
blocks.en: Analogy: the label is the device's "ID card"

blocks.zh: 好的標籤設計就像身分證：正面有照片（器材圖示）、姓名（器材名稱）、身分證號（REF）、出生日期（製造日）、有效期（失效日）、特殊標記（警示符號）。所有資訊都在固定位置，讓醫護人員第一眼就能找到需要的資訊。
blocks.en: A good label design is like an ID card: a photo on the front (device graphic), a name (device name), an ID number (REF), a date of birth (date of manufacture), an expiry date, and special marks (warning symbols). Everything is in a fixed position, so healthcare workers can find the information they need at first glance.

blocks.zh: 空間有限時的優先順序
blocks.en: Priorities when space is limited

blocks.zh: 當標籤面積受限（如針頭帽、試管）時，ISO 15223-1 隱含的優先順序：
blocks.en: When label area is restricted (e.g., needle caps, tubes), the order of priority implied by ISO 15223-1 is:

blocks.zh: 安全相關符號（Caution、Biohazard）— 最高優先
blocks.en: Safety-related symbols (Caution, Biohazard) — highest priority

blocks.zh: 批次識別（LOT）— 召回必要
blocks.en: Lot identification (LOT) — needed for recalls

blocks.zh: 型號（REF）— 識別必要
blocks.en: Model number (REF) — needed for identification

blocks.zh: 有效期
blocks.en: Expiry date

blocks.zh: 其他識別資訊（GMDN、QTY）— 可移至外包裝
blocks.en: Other identification information (GMDN, QTY) — may be moved to the outer package

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR 801 和 EU MDR Annex I.23 均允許將部分資訊放在次級容器（次級包裝）而非直接容器上，前提是設計上保證資訊在使用前可被看到。
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR 801 and EU MDR Annex I.23 both allow some information to be placed on the secondary container (secondary packaging) rather than the immediate container, provided the design ensures the information can be seen before use.

blocks.zh: Annex B (Informative) — Use of General Prohibition and Negation Symbols 禁止與否定符號的構建
blocks.en: Annex B (Informative) — Use of General Prohibition and Negation Symbols

blocks.zh: 否定符號：CDMO 最常用的複合符號
blocks.en: Negation symbols: the compound symbols CDMOs use most

blocks.zh: Do Not Reuse（禁止重複使用）：法規意涵
blocks.en: Do Not Reuse: regulatory implications

blocks.zh: 「Do Not Reuse」符號（通常以「2」被划掉的圖示表示）是無菌單次使用器材上最重要的複合符號。
blocks.en: The "Do Not Reuse" symbol (usually shown as the numeral "2" crossed out) is the most important compound symbol on sterile single-use devices.

blocks.zh: FDA 立場：單次使用器材重複使用屬於 adulteration（摻假），製造商無法保證第三方重複使用後的安全性
blocks.en: FDA position: reuse of a single-use device constitutes adulteration, and the manufacturer cannot guarantee safety after reuse by a third party

blocks.zh: MDR 要求：EU MDR Annex I.23.4(d) 要求單次使用器材必須明確標示，使用 ISO 15223-1 符號
blocks.en: MDR requirement: EU MDR Annex I.23.4(d) requires single-use devices to be clearly marked, using the ISO 15223-1 symbol

blocks.zh: 醫院重複使用器材（SUDs Reprocessing）：美國允許醫院委託 FDA 註冊的第三方處理器（如 Stryker Sustainability Solutions）重新處理某些「單次使用」器材，但必須有獨立的 510(k) 許可
blocks.en: Hospital reuse (SUDs reprocessing): the US allows hospitals to commission FDA-registered third-party reprocessors (e.g., Stryker Sustainability Solutions) to reprocess certain "single-use" devices, but this requires a separate 510(k) clearance

blocks.zh: CDMO 義務：負責包裝的 CDMO 必須確保此符號的存在和正確性，即使器材設計由客戶負責
blocks.en: CDMO obligation: the CDMO responsible for packaging must ensure this symbol is present and correct, even when the device design is the client's responsibility

blocks.zh: Not Sterile vs STERILE：錯誤使用後果
blocks.en: Not Sterile vs STERILE: consequences of misuse

blocks.zh: 將「STERILE」符號放在非無菌產品上，或遺漏「Not Sterile」符號，是嚴重的標籤錯誤，可能導致：
blocks.en: Placing the "STERILE" symbol on a non-sterile product, or omitting the "Not Sterile" symbol, is a serious labeling error and may lead to:

blocks.zh: FDA Warning Letter（警告信）
blocks.en: An FDA Warning Letter

blocks.zh: 器材召回（Class I 等級，最嚴重）
blocks.en: A device recall (Class I, the most severe)

blocks.zh: 刑事責任（若導致患者受傷）
blocks.en: Criminal liability (if patients are injured)

blocks.zh: CE 標誌撤銷
blocks.en: Withdrawal of the CE mark

blocks.zh: 2022 年 FDA MAUDE 資料庫記錄了多起因「non-sterile device wrongly labelled STERILE」導致的術後感染事件。
blocks.en: In 2022, the FDA MAUDE database recorded several postoperative infection events caused by "non-sterile device wrongly labelled STERILE".

blocks.zh: 類比：否定符號如同「×」標記
blocks.en: Analogy: negation symbols are like the "×" mark

blocks.zh: 禁止圓圈就像交通標誌的「禁止進入」——紅色圓圈本身就是「禁止」的通用語言，不論文化背景。ISO 選擇這個設計正是因為其普世性：全球醫護人員看到紅色圓圈配斜線就知道是「禁止/不可」，再配合內部基礎符號告訴他們「禁止什麼」。
blocks.en: The prohibition circle is like the "no entry" traffic sign: a red circle by itself is a universal language for "prohibited", regardless of culture. ISO chose this design precisely because of its universality: healthcare workers worldwide recognize a red circle with a diagonal slash as "prohibited/do not", and the base symbol inside tells them what is prohibited.

blocks.zh: Non-Latex 否定符號的特殊考量
blocks.en: Special considerations for the Non-Latex negation symbol

blocks.zh: ISO 15223-1 沒有標準化「Latex-Free」符號（只標準化了「Contains Latex」）
blocks.en: ISO 15223-1 does not standardize a "Latex-Free" symbol (it standardizes only "Contains Latex")

blocks.zh: 「Non-Latex」聲明在 FDA 允許的情況下可以使用 Annex B 方法構建否定符號
blocks.en: Where FDA permits, a "Non-Latex" statement may use the Annex B method to construct a negation symbol

blocks.zh: 但 FDA 建議：對於嚴重乳膠過敏患者，文字聲明「This product contains no natural rubber latex」比符號更清楚、風險更低
blocks.en: But FDA recommends that, for patients with severe latex allergy, the text statement "This product contains no natural rubber latex" is clearer and lower risk than a symbol

blocks.zh: CDMO 建議做法：符號 + 文字聲明並用，特別是針對高風險患者群體（如脊柱裂患者）的器材
blocks.en: CDMO recommended practice: use both a symbol and a text statement, especially for devices intended for high-risk patient groups (e.g., spina bifida patients)

blocks.zh: Comprehensive Summary — All ISO 15223-1:2016 Symbol Categories 完整符號速查表
blocks.en: Comprehensive Summary — All ISO 15223-1:2016 Symbol Categories

blocks.zh: ISO 15223-1 vs ANSI/AAMI ST93 對照
blocks.en: ISO 15223-1 vs ANSI/AAMI ST93

blocks.zh: 美國市場除了 ISO 15223-1，亦使用 ANSI/AAMI ST93（美國醫療器材標籤符號標準），兩者高度兼容但存在差異。
blocks.en: In addition to ISO 15223-1, the US market also uses ANSI/AAMI ST93 (the US standard for medical device labeling symbols). The two are highly compatible but have differences.

blocks.zh: FDA 對 ISO 符號的政策
blocks.en: FDA policy on ISO symbols

blocks.zh: FDA 2016 年指南「Use of International Symbol Standard ISO 15223-1 on Medical Device Labels」確認：製造商可以使用 ISO 15223-1 符號代替或補充英文文字，但必須：
blocks.en: The 2016 FDA guidance "Use of International Symbol Standard ISO 15223-1 on Medical Device Labels" confirms that manufacturers may use ISO 15223-1 symbols in place of, or in addition to, English text, but they must:

blocks.zh: 在首頁（510(k)/PMA）中宣告使用了 ISO 15223-1
blocks.en: Declare the use of ISO 15223-1 on the cover page (510(k)/PMA)

blocks.zh: 包含符號說明（Glossary of Symbols）在標籤或 IFU 中
blocks.en: Include a symbols glossary (Glossary of Symbols) in the labeling or IFU

blocks.zh: 確保用戶能夠查詢各符號的含義
blocks.en: Ensure users can look up the meaning of each symbol

blocks.zh: FDA 510(k) 提交時，標籤審查（Labeling Review）是必要的，審查員會核對 ISO 符號的正確使用。
blocks.en: In an FDA 510(k) submission, a labeling review is required, and the reviewer will check that ISO symbols are used correctly.

blocks.zh: UDI Compliance: LOT / SN / REF in DSCSA & EU MDR UDI UDI合規應用
blocks.en: UDI Compliance: LOT / SN / REF in DSCSA & EU MDR UDI

blocks.zh: DSCSA 與 EU MDR UDI：CDMO 實施路線圖
blocks.en: DSCSA and EU MDR UDI: CDMO implementation roadmap

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA UDI 時間表（已生效）
blocks.en: US FDA UDI timeline (already in effect)

blocks.zh: 2013：Class III 器材（植入性、生命維持）— 強制 UDI
blocks.en: 2013: Class III devices (implantable, life-sustaining) — UDI mandatory

blocks.zh: 2015：Class II 器材 — 強制 UDI
blocks.en: 2015: Class II devices — UDI mandatory

blocks.zh: 2018：Class I 和豁免器材 — 強制 UDI
blocks.en: 2018: Class I and exempt devices — UDI mandatory

blocks.zh: 2022：所有 Class I 豁免器材完全合規截止
blocks.en: 2022: deadline for full compliance of all Class I exempt devices

blocks.zh: 現狀：所有美國市場醫療器材必須有 UDI，包含機器可讀（條碼/RFID）和人類可讀（ISO 符號）格式
blocks.en: Current status: all medical devices on the US market must have a UDI, in both machine-readable (barcode/RFID) and human-readable (ISO symbol) formats

blocks.zh: EU MDR UDI 時間表（2026 年重點）
blocks.en: EU MDR UDI timeline (2026 highlights)

blocks.zh: 2021 年 5 月：MDR 正式生效，UDI 要求逐步實施
blocks.en: May 2021: MDR formally entered into application, with UDI requirements phased in

blocks.zh: 2023 年：Class III 器材 UDI 強制
blocks.en: 2023: UDI mandatory for Class III devices

blocks.zh: 2025 年：Class IIa/IIb 器材 UDI 強制
blocks.en: 2025: UDI mandatory for Class IIa/IIb devices

blocks.zh: 2027 年：Class I 器材 UDI 強制（即將到來！）
blocks.en: 2027: UDI mandatory for Class I devices (coming soon!)

blocks.zh: EUDAMED：器材登錄模組已開放；UDI 資料必須在上市前完成登錄
blocks.en: EUDAMED: the device registration module is open; UDI data must be registered before placing on the market

blocks.zh: CDMO 在 UDI 合規中的角色
blocks.en: The CDMO's role in UDI compliance

blocks.zh: CDMO 通常不是法規意義上的「製造商」（Manufacturer），而是合約製造商。但 CDMO 必須：
blocks.en: A CDMO is usually not the "manufacturer" in the regulatory sense but a contract manufacturer. However, the CDMO must:

blocks.zh: 確保標籤（包括所有 ISO 符號）符合客戶的 UDI 規格
blocks.en: Ensure labels (including all ISO symbols) conform to the client's UDI specifications

blocks.zh: 保存批次記錄（LOT 對應的所有製程數據），支持客戶的 UDI 可追溯性
blocks.en: Retain batch records (all process data for each LOT) to support the client's UDI traceability

blocks.zh: 在 QTA（品質技術協議）中明確規定 UDI 標籤的核對責任
blocks.en: Specify clearly in the QTA (quality technical agreement) who is responsible for checking UDI labels

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 作為授權製造商（Authorized Manufacturer）需負責 UDI 登錄
blocks.en: Be responsible for UDI registration if the CDMO acts as the authorized manufacturer

blocks.zh: DSCSA（藥品供應鏈安全法）與 UDI 的交叉
blocks.en: Where DSCSA (Drug Supply Chain Security Act) and UDI intersect

blocks.zh: 雖然 DSCSA（Drug Supply Chain Security Act, 2013）主要針對藥品，但對「藥品-器材組合產品」（Combination Products）的 CDMO 有特殊影響：
blocks.en: Although the DSCSA (Drug Supply Chain Security Act, 2013) is aimed mainly at drugs, it has particular implications for CDMOs handling drug-device combination products:

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器（藥品 + 注射器）：同時受 DSCSA 和 UDI 規範
blocks.en: Prefilled syringes (drug + syringe): subject to both DSCSA and UDI rules

blocks.zh: 藥品端：需要 DSCSA 序列化（Serialization）和 SNDC（Standardized Numerical Identifier）
blocks.en: Drug side: requires DSCSA serialization and the SNDC (Standardized Numerical Identifier)

blocks.zh: 器材端：需要 UDI（LOT/SN/REF 符號）
blocks.en: Device side: requires UDI (LOT/SN/REF symbols)

blocks.zh: CDMO 需確保標籤系統能同時輸出符合兩套系統的資料
blocks.en: The CDMO must ensure its labeling system can output data that satisfies both systems at the same time

blocks.zh: 製藥 CDMO 標籤設計合規清單 Label Compliance Checklist
blocks.en: Pharma CDMO label design compliance checklist

blocks.zh: 合規清單（續）與品管要點
blocks.en: Compliance checklist (continued) and QC points

blocks.zh: 標籤設計常見 483/Warning Letter 原因
blocks.en: Common causes of label-related 483s/Warning Letters

blocks.zh: Critical 標籤印「STERILE」但器材未經驗證的滅菌流程
blocks.en: Critical Label says "STERILE" but the device has not undergone a validated sterilization process

blocks.en: Critical LOT number format inconsistent with the batch record (traceability not possible)

blocks.en: Major Expiry date format non-compliant (FDA requires YYYY-MM-DD)

blocks.zh: 標籤驗證（Label Verification）流程
blocks.en: Label verification process

blocks.zh: CDMO 建議的標籤驗證步驟：
blocks.en: CDMO recommended label verification steps:

blocks.zh: 設計審查：QA + Regulatory 雙重審查符號選用是否符合 ISO 15223-1
blocks.en: Design review: dual review by QA + Regulatory of whether the symbols selected conform to ISO 15223-1

blocks.zh: 讀取性測試：在最差情況（最小字體、最遠閱讀距離）下驗證所有符號可讀
blocks.en: Legibility testing: verify that all symbols are legible under worst-case conditions (smallest font, longest reading distance)

blocks.zh: 條碼驗證：用 ISO/IEC 15415 標準驗證 DataMatrix 品質（Grade C 以上）
blocks.en: Barcode verification: verify DataMatrix quality to the ISO/IEC 15415 standard (Grade C or above)

blocks.zh: 使用者研究：對於新符號組合，建議進行有代表性用戶的可用性測試（FDA 推薦）
blocks.en: User studies: for new symbol combinations, usability testing with representative users is recommended (FDA recommendation)

blocks.zh: 多市場審查：確認各目標市場的法規差異已納入標籤設計
blocks.en: Multi-market review: confirm that the regulatory differences of each target market have been incorporated into the label design

blocks.en: A CDMO receives a label artwork from a client showing "STERILE" on a device that will be sold non-sterile (to be sterilized by the hospital). What should the CDMO do?

blocks.zh: A Class III implantable cardiac stent must comply with EU MDR Article 27. List all the ISO 15223-1 symbols that must appear on its label, explaining the UDI rationale for each. (心臟支架標籤必備的 ISO 符號清單）)
blocks.en: A Class III implantable cardiac stent must comply with EU MDR Article 27. List all the ISO 15223-1 symbols that must appear on its label, explaining the UDI rationale for each.

blocks.zh: A CDMO is producing a prefilled syringe containing an anticoagulant (heparin sodium). The rubber plunger stopper is made from natural rubber latex. List all precautionary symbols required on the label for US + EU dual-market registration. (肝素預填充注射器的雙市場標籤要求）)
blocks.en: A CDMO is producing a prefilled syringe containing an anticoagulant (heparin sodium). The rubber plunger stopper is made from natural rubber latex. List all precautionary symbols required on the label for US + EU dual-market registration.

blocks.en: Explain the difference between the "Do Not Reuse" symbol and the "Single Use" symbol (ISO 7000-1051 area). Can a device be labelled "Single Use" without the "Do Not Reuse" compound symbol?

blocks.zh: Case Analysis 案例分析
blocks.en: Case Analysis

blocks.zh: 案例 1：LOT 符號錯誤導致的召回擴大
blocks.en: Case 1: a LOT symbol error that enlarged a recall

blocks.zh: 情境：一家 CDMO 生產的無菌注射針頭，由於標籤列印系統故障，部分批次的 LOT 號印成前一批次的號碼。出現感染事件後，召回範圍本來只需包含 LOT 26A10-005（約 50,000 支），但由於 LOT 號重疊，必須同時召回 LOT 26A09-005（約 50,000 支），召回規模翻倍。
blocks.en: Scenario: At a CDMO producing sterile injection needles, a malfunction of the label printing system caused some batches to be printed with the previous batch's lot number. After an infection event, the recall should have covered only LOT 26A10-005 (about 50,000 units), but because the LOT numbers overlapped, LOT 26A09-005 (about 50,000 units) also had to be recalled, doubling the recall scale.

blocks.zh: 根本原因：LOT 符號正確（印了 LOT），但對應的數字內容錯誤。標籤列印驗證（Label Print Verification, LPV）系統未設置自動核對批次號與批製造令（BMR）一致性。
blocks.en: Root cause: the LOT symbol was correct (LOT was printed), but the number itself was wrong. The Label Print Verification (LPV) system had no automatic check that the lot number matched the batch manufacturing record (BMR).

blocks.zh: 改善措施：
blocks.en: Corrective actions:

blocks.zh: 實施自動視覺檢測（Automated Vision Inspection）核對 LOT 號
blocks.en: Implement automated vision inspection to verify the LOT number

blocks.zh: 在批次記錄中加入標籤樣本存檔
blocks.en: Add label sample retention to the batch record

blocks.zh: 建立 LOT 號唯一性資料庫，防止重複使用
blocks.en: Build a LOT number uniqueness database to prevent reuse

blocks.zh: 案例 2：IVD 符號缺失的 EUDAMED 登錄失敗
blocks.en: Case 2: missing IVD symbol and a failed EUDAMED registration

blocks.zh: 情境：一家 CDMO 客戶的 COVID-19 快篩試劑盒已完成 IVDR Technical Documentation（技術文件），在 EUDAMED 完成 UDI 登錄，但在上市前稽查時發現：商業標籤設計稿缺少 IVD 符號（EU IVDR 2017/746 強制要求）。
blocks.en: Scenario: A CDMO client's COVID-19 rapid test kit had completed its IVDR technical documentation and its UDI registration in EUDAMED, but a pre-market audit found that the commercial label artwork lacked the IVD symbol (mandatory under EU IVDR 2017/746).

blocks.zh: 影響：需重新修訂標籤 → 重新提交 Notified Body 審查（因標籤屬於技術文件的一部分）→ 上市延遲 3 個月。
blocks.en: Impact: the label had to be revised and resubmitted for Notified Body review (because the label is part of the technical documentation), delaying market launch by 3 months.

blocks.zh: 教訓：CDMO 的標籤設計審查流程應有專屬的「IVDR 特定符號清單」，IVD 符號應在設計初期即納入，不可在最終稽查前才發現遺漏。
blocks.en: Lesson: the CDMO's label design review process should include a dedicated "IVDR-specific symbol checklist". The IVD symbol should be built in at the start of design, not discovered missing just before the final audit.

blocks.zh: 案例 3：Biohazard 符號爭議
blocks.en: Case 3: the Biohazard symbol dispute

blocks.zh: 情境：一家製造血糖試紙的 CDMO 被客戶要求在試紙盒上印 Biohazard 符號，因為試紙使用後「可能接觸血液」。
blocks.en: Scenario: A CDMO manufacturing blood glucose test strips was asked by the client to print the Biohazard symbol on the strip box because used strips "may contact blood".

blocks.zh: ISO 15223-1 分析：ISO 標準規定 Biohazard 符號用於「確實存在感染傳播風險」的器材。未使用的試紙不含血液，不應標示 Biohazard。
blocks.en: ISO 15223-1 analysis: the ISO standard specifies the Biohazard symbol for devices where there is a real risk of transmitting infection. Unused strips contain no blood and should not be marked Biohazard.

blocks.zh: CDMO 正確做法：
blocks.en: Correct CDMO approach:

blocks.zh: 新試紙盒：不應印 Biohazard 符號
blocks.en: New strip box: should not carry the Biohazard symbol

blocks.zh: 廢棄試紙容器（收集使用後試紙）：應印 Biohazard 符號
blocks.en: Waste strip container (for collecting used strips): should carry the Biohazard symbol

blocks.zh: 在 IFU 中加入廢棄物處理說明，提醒用戶使用後的試紙應視為潛在生物危害
blocks.en: Add waste handling instructions to the IFU, reminding users that used strips should be treated as a potential biohazard

blocks.zh: CDMO 應在 QTA 中明確規定此類符號使用決策的審核責任歸屬。
blocks.en: The CDMO should specify in the QTA who is responsible for reviewing decisions on the use of such symbols.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧：三個最重要的 CDMO 啟示
blocks.en: Key takeaways: the three most important lessons for CDMOs

blocks.zh: LOT 符號是召回的精準度：LOT 號的唯一性和可追溯性直接決定召回範圍的大小。CDMO 的批次號設計和標籤列印驗證是品質體系的關鍵節點。
blocks.en: The LOT symbol is the precision of a recall: the uniqueness and traceability of the LOT number directly determine the scope of a recall. A CDMO's lot number design and label print verification are critical nodes in the quality system.

blocks.zh: IVD + IVDR = 新義務：2027 年後，所有歐盟 IVD 產品（包括 Class A 一般試劑）必須有完整的 UDI 和 IVD 符號。CDMO 服務 IVD 客戶需提前規劃。
blocks.en: IVD + IVDR = new obligations: after 2027, all EU IVD products (including Class A general reagents) must carry a full UDI and the IVD symbol. CDMOs serving IVD clients need to plan ahead.

blocks.zh: Biohazard ≠ 任何接觸血液的器材：正確使用（而非過度使用）Biohazard 符號是 CDMO 標籤合規的細節體現。過度標示會造成警示疲勞，而標示不足則是合規缺陷。
blocks.en: Biohazard ≠ any device that touches blood: correct use (not overuse) of the Biohazard symbol reflects attention to detail in CDMO label compliance. Over-marking causes alert fatigue, while under-marking is a compliance deficiency.
